Tortillas

Time: 10-20min
Servings: 1-many
Source: Šandyna
Tags: tested, savory, snack, main-course, lazy, simple, vegetarian, meat, gluten-free, milk-free

Depending on what you buy, you can accomodate various dietary restrictions. There are gluten-free tortillas, diary-free mayo, meat substitutes… Recipe is listed in its original version, but feel free to replace anything.
It’s also an excellent way of finishing random things lying around in the fridge. A bit of cheese, unfinished can of beans, three leftover mushrooms, they can all go in. If you buy a head of lettuce and a bag of tomatoes, this meal can be eaten for a few days, until you run out.

Ingredients

  • 1 pack tortillas (!)
  • 4-5 chicken nuggies (!)
  • salad
  • tomatoes
  • mayo (!)

Optional Ingredients

  • Avocado
  • Any vegetable you like, fresh or canned
  • Roasted mushrooms
  • Sour cream, yoghurt (!)
  • Oregano, dill or garlic powder
  • Cheese, grated or sliced (!)

Instructions

Bake chicken nuggies according to instructions.
Prepare veggies while the nuggies are baking. Wash, cut, do whatever you do.
Microwave tortilla for 30s if you can be bothered. Spread mayo in a stripe in the middle. Apply any herbs or seasoning on it.
Put nuggies on the mayo. Put veggies on the nuggies. Wrap. Eat.
